+"""Admin SLA policy management routes."""
+
+from typing import Annotated
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, Request
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from app.api.dependencies.auth import get_current_principal
+from app.api.dependencies.db import get_db_session
+from app.domain.iam import Principal
+from app.schema.common import request_id_for, success_envelope
+from app.schema.sla import (
+    EffectiveSlaPolicyData,
+    PutSlaPolicyRequest,
+    SlaPolicyData,
+    SlaPolicyListData,
+)
+from app.service.sla_policy import SlaPolicyListing, SlaPolicyService
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/admin", tags=["admin-sla"])
+
+
+def get_sla_policy_service(
+    session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db_session)],
+) -> SlaPolicyService:
+    return SlaPolicyService(session)
+
+
+def _policy_data(record) -> SlaPolicyData:
+    return SlaPolicyData(
+        id=record.id,
+        tenant_id=record.tenant_id,
+        property_id=record.property_id,
+        scope_type="TENANT" if record.property_id is None else "PROPERTY",
+        category=record.category,
+        priority=record.priority,
+        respond_minutes=record.respond_minutes,
+        complete_minutes=record.complete_minutes,
+        status=record.status,
+        updated_at=record.updated_at,
+    )
+
+
+def _listing_data(listing: SlaPolicyListing) -> SlaPolicyListData:
+    return SlaPolicyListData(
+        property_id=listing.property_id,
+        items=[_policy_data(record) for record in listing.items],
+        effective=[
+            EffectiveSlaPolicyData(
+                category=item.category,
+                priority=item.priority,
+                source=item.source,
+                policy_id=item.policy_id,
+                respond_minutes=item.respond_minutes,
+                complete_minutes=item.complete_minutes,
+            )
+            for item in listing.effective
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/sla-policies")
+def list_sla_policies(
+    request: Request,
+    actor: Annotated[Principal, Depends(get_current_principal)],
+    service: Annotated[SlaPolicyService, Depends(get_sla_policy_service)],
+    property_id: Annotated[int, Query(gt=0)],
+    tenant_id: Annotated[int | None, Query(gt=0)] = None,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    listing = service.list_for_property(
+        actor=actor,
+        property_id=property_id,
+        claimed_tenant_id=tenant_id,
+    )
+    return success_envelope(
+        request,
+        _listing_data(listing).model_dump(mode="json"),
+    )
+
+
+@router.put("/sla-policies")
+def put_sla_policy(
+    body: PutSlaPolicyRequest,
+    request: Request,
+    actor: Annotated[Principal, Depends(get_current_principal)],
+    service: Annotated[SlaPolicyService, Depends(get_sla_policy_service)],
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    record = service.put_policy(
+        actor=actor,
+        tenant_id=body.tenant_id,
+        property_id=body.property_id,
+        category=body.category,
+        priority=body.priority,
+        respond_minutes=body.respond_minutes,
+        complete_minutes=body.complete_minutes,
+        status=body.status,
+        expected_updated_at=body.expected_updated_at,
+        request_id=request_id_for(request),
+    )
+    return success_envelope(
+        request,
+        _policy_data(record).model_dump(mode="json"),
+    )

 class AppError(Exception):
     """Expected business/application error with a stable public code."""
 
     def __init__(
         self,
         *,
         code: str,
         message: str,
         status_code: int,
         details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
     ) -> None:
         super().__init__(message)
         self.code = code
         self.message = message
         self.status_code = status_code
         self.details = details or {}

+"""SLA policy management request and response contracts."""
+
+from datetime import datetime
+from typing import Literal, Self
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator
+
+
+SlaCategory = Literal[
+    "PLUMBING",
+    "ELECTRICAL",
+    "HVAC",
+    "CLEANING",
+    "SECURITY",
+    "OTHER",
+]
+SlaPriority = Literal["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "URGENT"]
+SlaPolicyState = Literal["ACTIVE", "DISABLED"]
+
+
+class PutSlaPolicyRequest(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+
+    tenant_id: int = Field(strict=True, gt=0)
+    property_id: int | None = Field(default=None, strict=True, gt=0)
+    category: SlaCategory
+    priority: SlaPriority
+    respond_minutes: int = Field(strict=True, ge=1, le=2_147_483_647)
+    complete_minutes: int = Field(strict=True, ge=1, le=2_147_483_647)
+    status: SlaPolicyState = "ACTIVE"
+    expected_updated_at: datetime | None = None
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def validate_window_order(self) -> Self:
+        if self.respond_minutes > self.complete_minutes:
+            raise ValueError("respond_minutes must not exceed complete_minutes")
+        return self
+
+
+class SlaPolicyData(BaseModel):
+    id: int
+    tenant_id: int
+    property_id: int | None
+    scope_type: Literal["TENANT", "PROPERTY"]
+    category: SlaCategory
+    priority: SlaPriority
+    respond_minutes: int
+    complete_minutes: int
+    status: SlaPolicyState
+    updated_at: datetime
+
+
+class EffectiveSlaPolicyData(BaseModel):
+    category: SlaCategory
+    priority: SlaPriority
+    source: Literal["PROPERTY", "TENANT", "CODE_DEFAULT"]
+    policy_id: int | None
+    respond_minutes: int
+    complete_minutes: int
+
+
+class SlaPolicyListData(BaseModel):
+    property_id: int
+    items: list[SlaPolicyData]
+    effective: list[EffectiveSlaPolicyData]

+"""Scoped, audited SLA policy administration on the existing 0009 schema."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError, SQLAlchemyError
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from app.core.database import run_owned_transaction
+from app.core.errors import AppError, AuthErrorCode, ErrorCode, IamErrorCode, SlaErrorCode
+from app.domain.audit import AuditAction, AuditResourceType

+from app.domain.work_order import (
+    DEFAULT_SLA_COMPLETE_MINUTES,
+    DEFAULT_SLA_RESPOND_MINUTES,
+    SLA_POLICY_MANAGE,
+    SlaPolicyStatus,
+    WorkOrderCategory,
+    WorkOrderPriority,
+)
+from app.model.work_order import SlaPolicy
+from app.repository.identity import IdentityRepository
+from app.repository.property import PropertyRepository
+from app.repository.work_order import WorkOrderRepository
+from app.service.audit import AuditService
+from app.service.auth import AuthService
+from app.service.rbac import RbacService
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EffectiveSlaPolicy:
+    category: str
+    priority: str
+    source: str
+    policy_id: int | None
+    respond_minutes: int
+    complete_minutes: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SlaPolicyListing:
+    property_id: int
+    items: tuple[SlaPolicy, ...]
+    effective: tuple[EffectiveSlaPolicy, ...]
+
+
+class SlaPolicyService:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        session: Session,
+        *,
+        repository: WorkOrderRepository | None = None,
+        property_repository: PropertyRepository | None = None,
+        audit_service: AuditService | None = None,
+        principal_loader: Callable[[int], Principal] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._session = session
+        self._repository = repository or WorkOrderRepository(session)
+        self._properties = property_repository or PropertyRepository(session)
+        self._audit = audit_service or AuditService(session)
+        self._principal_loader = principal_loader or AuthService(
+            session,
+            IdentityRepository(session),
+        ).load_principal
+
+    def list_for_property(
+        self,
+        *,
+        actor: Principal,
+        property_id: int,
+        claimed_tenant_id: int | None = None,
+    ) -> SlaPolicyListing:
+        property_record = self._properties.get_property_by_id(property_id)
+        if property_record is None:
+            self._raise_forbidden()
+        if claimed_tenant_id is not None and claimed_tenant_id != property_record.tenant_id:
+            self._raise_forbidden()
+        tenant = self._properties.get_tenant(property_record.tenant_id)
+        if tenant is None or tenant.status != "ACTIVE":
+            self._raise_forbidden()
+        scope = OrganizationScope(
+            ScopeType.PROPERTY,
+            tenant_id=property_record.tenant_id,
+            property_id=property_record.id,
+        )
+        RbacService.require_permission(actor, SLA_POLICY_MANAGE, scope)
+        records = self._repository.list_sla_policies_for_property(
+            tenant_id=property_record.tenant_id,
+            property_id=property_record.id,
+        )
+        return SlaPolicyListing(
+            property_id=property_record.id,
+            items=records,
+            effective=self._effective(records, property_id=property_record.id),
+        )
+
+    def put_policy(
+        self,
+        *,
+        actor: Principal,
+        tenant_id: int,
+        property_id: int | None,
+        category: str,
+        priority: str,
+        respond_minutes: int,
+        complete_minutes: int,
+        status: str,
+        expected_updated_at: datetime | None,
+        request_id: str,
+    ) -> SlaPolicy:
+        def operation() -> SlaPolicy:
+            current = self._reload_actor(actor)
+            scope = self._locked_scope(
+                tenant_id=tenant_id,
+                property_id=property_id,
+            )
+            RbacService.require_permission(current, SLA_POLICY_MANAGE, scope)
+            parsed_category, parsed_priority, parsed_status = self._validate_values(
+                category=category,
+                priority=priority,
+                status=status,
+                respond_minutes=respond_minutes,
+                complete_minutes=complete_minutes,
+            )
+            if property_id is None and parsed_status is SlaPolicyStatus.DISABLED:
+                raise AppError(
+                    code=SlaErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT,
+                    message="Tenant default SLA policy cannot be disabled",
+                    status_code=422,
+                )
+            record = self._repository.get_sla_policy_for_update(
+                tenant_id=tenant_id,
+                property_id=property_id,
+                category=parsed_category.value,
+                priority=parsed_priority.value,
+            )
+            requested = {
+                "respond_minutes": respond_minutes,
+                "complete_minutes": complete_minutes,
+                "status": parsed_status.value,
+            }
+            if record is not None:
+                before = self._snapshot(record)
+                if all(before[key] == value for key, value in requested.items()):
+                    return record
+                if expected_updated_at is None or record.updated_at != expected_updated_at:
+                    raise AppError(
+                        code=SlaErrorCode.CONFLICT,
+                        message="SLA policy changed; refresh before saving",
+                        status_code=409,
+                        details={"retryable": True},
+                    )
+                record.respond_minutes = respond_minutes
+                record.complete_minutes = complete_minutes
+                record.status = parsed_status.value
+                self._repository.flush_sla_policy(record)
+            else:
+                before = None
+                record = self._repository.add_sla_policy(
+                    SlaPolicy(
+                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
+                        property_id=property_id,
+                        category=parsed_category.value,
+                        priority=parsed_priority.value,
+                        respond_minutes=respond_minutes,
+                        complete_minutes=complete_minutes,
+                        status=parsed_status.value,
+                    )
+                )
+            self._audit.append(
+                action=AuditAction.SLA_POLICY_CHANGED,
+                resource_type=AuditResourceType.SLA_POLICY,
+                actor_user_id=current.user_id,
+                resource_id=record.id,
+                request_id=request_id,
+                scope_type=scope.scope_type,
+                tenant_id=scope.tenant_id,
+                property_id=scope.property_id,
+                details={
+                    "scope_type": scope.scope_type.value,
+                    "property_id": property_id,
+                    "category": record.category,
+                    "priority": record.priority,
+                    "before": before,
+                    "after": self._snapshot(record),
+                },
+            )
+            return record
+
+        try:
+            return run_owned_transaction(self._session, operation)
+        except AppError:
+            raise
+        except IntegrityError as exc:
+            raise AppError(
+                code=SlaErrorCode.CONFLICT,
+                message="SLA policy conflicted with current data",
+                status_code=409,
+                details={"retryable": True},
+            ) from exc
+        except SQLAlchemyError as exc:
+            raise AppError(
+                code=ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR,
+                message="SLA policy could not be saved",
+                status_code=500,
+            ) from exc
+
+    def _locked_scope(
+        self,
+        *,
+        tenant_id: int,
+        property_id: int | None,
+    ) -> OrganizationScope:
+        if property_id is None:
+            tenant = self._properties.get_tenant_for_update(tenant_id)
+            if tenant is None or tenant.status != "ACTIVE":
+                self._raise_forbidden()
+            return OrganizationScope(ScopeType.TENANT, tenant_id=tenant.id)
+        property_record = self._properties.get_property_by_id_for_update(property_id)
+        if property_record is None or property_record.tenant_id != tenant_id:
+            self._raise_forbidden()
+        tenant = self._properties.get_tenant(property_record.tenant_id)
+        if tenant is None or tenant.status != "ACTIVE":
+            self._raise_forbidden()
+        return OrganizationScope(
+            ScopeType.PROPERTY,
+            tenant_id=property_record.tenant_id,
+            property_id=property_record.id,
+        )
+
+    def _reload_actor(self, actor: Principal) -> Principal:
+        if actor.status != "ACTIVE":
+            raise AppError(
+                code=AuthErrorCode.USER_DISABLED,
+                message="User is not active",
+                status_code=401,
+            )
+        try:
+            current = self._principal_loader(actor.user_id)
+        except AppError as exc:
+            raise AppError(
+                code=IamErrorCode.FORBIDDEN,
+                message="Permission denied",
+                status_code=403,
+            ) from exc
+        if current.user_id != actor.user_id or current.status != "ACTIVE":
+            self._raise_forbidden()
+        return current
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_values(
+        *,
+        category: str,
+        priority: str,
+        status: str,
+        respond_minutes: int,
+        complete_minutes: int,
+    ) -> tuple[WorkOrderCategory, WorkOrderPriority, SlaPolicyStatus]:
+        if (
+            isinstance(respond_minutes, bool)
+            or isinstance(complete_minutes, bool)
+            or respond_minutes < 1
+            or complete_minutes < 1
+            or respond_minutes > complete_minutes
+        ):
+            raise AppError(
+                code=SlaErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT,
+                message=(
+                    "SLA minutes must be positive and the response window "
+                    "must not exceed the completion window"
+                ),
+                status_code=422,
+            )
+        try:
+            return (
+                WorkOrderCategory(category),
+                WorkOrderPriority(priority),
+                SlaPolicyStatus(status),
+            )
+        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise AppError(
+                code=SlaErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT,
+                message="SLA category, priority, or status is invalid",
+                status_code=422,
+            ) from exc
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _snapshot(record: SlaPolicy) -> dict[str, object]:
+        return {
+            "respond_minutes": int(record.respond_minutes),
+            "complete_minutes": int(record.complete_minutes),
+            "status": str(record.status),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _effective(
+        records: tuple[SlaPolicy, ...],
+        *,
+        property_id: int,
+    ) -> tuple[EffectiveSlaPolicy, ...]:
+        active = {
+            (record.property_id, record.category, record.priority): record
+            for record in records
+            if record.status == SlaPolicyStatus.ACTIVE.value
+        }
+        resolved: list[EffectiveSlaPolicy] = []
+        for category in WorkOrderCategory:
+            for priority in WorkOrderPriority:
+                record = active.get((property_id, category.value, priority.value))
+                source = "PROPERTY"
+                if record is None:
+                    record = active.get((None, category.value, priority.value))
+                    source = "TENANT"
+                if record is None:
+                    source = "CODE_DEFAULT"
+                    policy_id = None
+                    respond_minutes = DEFAULT_SLA_RESPOND_MINUTES[priority]
+                    complete_minutes = DEFAULT_SLA_COMPLETE_MINUTES[priority]
+                else:
+                    policy_id = record.id
+                    respond_minutes = record.respond_minutes
+                    complete_minutes = record.complete_minutes
+                resolved.append(
+                    EffectiveSlaPolicy(
+                        category=category.value,
+                        priority=priority.value,
+                        source=source,
+                        policy_id=policy_id,
+                        respond_minutes=respond_minutes,
+                        complete_minutes=complete_minutes,
+                    )
+                )
+        return tuple(resolved)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _raise_forbidden() -> None:
+        raise AppError(
+            code=IamErrorCode.FORBIDDEN,
+            message="Permission denied",
+            status_code=403,
+        )

 def _content_matches_mime(mime_type: str, content: bytes) -> bool:
     if mime_type == "image/jpeg":
         return content.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff")
     if mime_type == "image/png":
         return content.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
     if mime_type == "image/webp":
         return (
             len(content) >= 12
             and content.startswith(b"RIFF")
             and content[8:12] == b"WEBP"
         )
     if mime_type == "audio/mpeg":
         return content.startswith(b"ID3") or (
             len(content) >= 2
             and content[0] == 0xFF
             and content[1] & 0xE0 == 0xE0

"""Scoped, audited SLA policy administration on the existing 0009 schema."""

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError, SQLAlchemyError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.database import run_owned_transaction
from app.core.errors import AppError, AuthErrorCode, ErrorCode, IamErrorCode, SlaErrorCode
from app.domain.audit import AuditAction, AuditResourceType
from app.domain.iam import OrganizationScope, Principal, ScopeType
from app.domain.work_order import (
    DEFAULT_SLA_COMPLETE_MINUTES,
    DEFAULT_SLA_RESPOND_MINUTES,
    SLA_POLICY_MANAGE,
    SlaPolicyStatus,
    WorkOrderCategory,
    WorkOrderPriority,
)
from app.model.work_order import SlaPolicy
from app.repository.identity import IdentityRepository
from app.repository.property import PropertyRepository
from app.repository.work_order import WorkOrderRepository
from app.service.audit import AuditService
from app.service.auth import AuthService
from app.service.rbac import RbacService


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EffectiveSlaPolicy:
    category: str
    priority: str
    source: str
    policy_id: int | None
    respond_minutes: int
    complete_minutes: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SlaPolicyListing:
    property_id: int
    items: tuple[SlaPolicy, ...]
    effective: tuple[EffectiveSlaPolicy, ...]


class SlaPolicyService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        session: Session,
        *,
        repository: WorkOrderRepository | None = None,
        property_repository: PropertyRepository | None = None,
        audit_service: AuditService | None = None,
        principal_loader: Callable[[int], Principal] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._session = session
        self._repository = repository or WorkOrderRepository(session)
        self._properties = property_repository or PropertyRepository(session)
        self._audit = audit_service or AuditService(session)
        self._principal_loader = principal_loader or AuthService(
            session,
            IdentityRepository(session),
        ).load_principal

    def list_for_property(
        self,
        *,
        actor: Principal,
        property_id: int,
        claimed_tenant_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> SlaPolicyListing:
        property_record = self._properties.get_property_by_id(property_id)
        if property_record is None:
            self._raise_forbidden()
        if claimed_tenant_id is not None and claimed_tenant_id != property_record.tenant_id:
            self._raise_forbidden()
        tenant = self._properties.get_tenant(property_record.tenant_id)
        if tenant is None or tenant.status != "ACTIVE":
            self._raise_forbidden()
        scope = OrganizationScope(
            ScopeType.PROPERTY,
            tenant_id=property_record.tenant_id,
            property_id=property_record.id,
        )
        RbacService.require_permission(actor, SLA_POLICY_MANAGE, scope)
        records = self._repository.list_sla_policies_for_property(
            tenant_id=property_record.tenant_id,
            property_id=property_record.id,
        )
        return SlaPolicyListing(
            property_id=property_record.id,
            items=records,
            effective=self._effective(records, property_id=property_record.id),
        )

    def put_policy(
        self,
        *,
        actor: Principal,
        tenant_id: int,
        property_id: int | None,
        category: str,
        priority: str,
        respond_minutes: int,
        complete_minutes: int,
        status: str,
        expected_updated_at: datetime | None,
        request_id: str,
    ) -> SlaPolicy:
        def operation() -> SlaPolicy:
            current = self._reload_actor(actor)
            scope = self._locked_scope(
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                property_id=property_id,
            )
            RbacService.require_permission(current, SLA_POLICY_MANAGE, scope)
            parsed_category, parsed_priority, parsed_status = self._validate_values(
                category=category,
                priority=priority,
                status=status,
                respond_minutes=respond_minutes,
                complete_minutes=complete_minutes,
            )
            if property_id is None and parsed_status is SlaPolicyStatus.DISABLED:
                raise AppError(
                    code=SlaErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT,
                    message="Tenant default SLA policy cannot be disabled",
                    status_code=422,
                )
            record = self._repository.get_sla_policy_for_update(
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                property_id=property_id,
                category=parsed_category.value,
                priority=parsed_priority.value,
            )
            requested = {
                "respond_minutes": respond_minutes,
                "complete_minutes": complete_minutes,
                "status": parsed_status.value,
            }
            if record is not None:
                before = self._snapshot(record)
                if all(before[key] == value for key, value in requested.items()):
                    return record
                if expected_updated_at is None or record.updated_at != expected_updated_at:
                    raise AppError(
                        code=SlaErrorCode.CONFLICT,
                        message="SLA policy changed; refresh before saving",
                        status_code=409,
                        details={"retryable": True},
                    )
                record.respond_minutes = respond_minutes
                record.complete_minutes = complete_minutes
                record.status = parsed_status.value
                self._repository.flush_sla_policy(record)
            else:
                before = None
                record = self._repository.add_sla_policy(
                    SlaPolicy(
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        property_id=property_id,
                        category=parsed_category.value,
                        priority=parsed_priority.value,
                        respond_minutes=respond_minutes,
                        complete_minutes=complete_minutes,
                        status=parsed_status.value,
                    )
                )
            self._audit.append(
                action=AuditAction.SLA_POLICY_CHANGED,
                resource_type=AuditResourceType.SLA_POLICY,
                actor_user_id=current.user_id,
                resource_id=record.id,
                request_id=request_id,
                scope_type=scope.scope_type,
                tenant_id=scope.tenant_id,
                property_id=scope.property_id,
                details={
                    "scope_type": scope.scope_type.value,
                    "property_id": property_id,
                    "category": record.category,
                    "priority": record.priority,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": self._snapshot(record),
                },
            )
            return record

        try:
            return run_owned_transaction(self._session, operation)
        except AppError:
            raise
        except IntegrityError as exc:
            raise AppError(
                code=SlaErrorCode.CONFLICT,
                message="SLA policy conflicted with current data",
                status_code=409,
                details={"retryable": True},
            ) from exc
        except SQLAlchemyError as exc:
            raise AppError(
                code=ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR,
                message="SLA policy could not be saved",
                status_code=500,
            ) from exc

    def _locked_scope(
        self,
        *,
        tenant_id: int,
        property_id: int | None,
    ) -> OrganizationScope:
        if property_id is None:
            tenant = self._properties.get_tenant_for_update(tenant_id)
            if tenant is None or tenant.status != "ACTIVE":
                self._raise_forbidden()
            return OrganizationScope(ScopeType.TENANT, tenant_id=tenant.id)
        property_record = self._properties.get_property_by_id_for_update(property_id)
        if property_record is None or property_record.tenant_id != tenant_id:
            self._raise_forbidden()
        tenant = self._properties.get_tenant(property_record.tenant_id)
        if tenant is None or tenant.status != "ACTIVE":
            self._raise_forbidden()
        return OrganizationScope(
            ScopeType.PROPERTY,
            tenant_id=property_record.tenant_id,
            property_id=property_record.id,
        )

    def _reload_actor(self, actor: Principal) -> Principal:
        if actor.status != "ACTIVE":
            raise AppError(
                code=AuthErrorCode.USER_DISABLED,
                message="User is not active",
                status_code=401,
            )
        try:
            current = self._principal_loader(actor.user_id)
        except AppError as exc:
            raise AppError(
                code=IamErrorCode.FORBIDDEN,
                message="Permission denied",
                status_code=403,
            ) from exc
        if current.user_id != actor.user_id or current.status != "ACTIVE":
            self._raise_forbidden()
        return current

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_values(
        *,
        category: str,
        priority: str,
        status: str,
        respond_minutes: int,
        complete_minutes: int,
    ) -> tuple[WorkOrderCategory, WorkOrderPriority, SlaPolicyStatus]:
        if (
            isinstance(respond_minutes, bool)
            or isinstance(complete_minutes, bool)
            or respond_minutes < 1
            or complete_minutes < 1
            or respond_minutes > complete_minutes
        ):
            raise AppError(
                code=SlaErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT,
                message=(
                    "SLA minutes must be positive and the response window "
                    "must not exceed the completion window"
                ),
                status_code=422,
            )
        try:
            return (
                WorkOrderCategory(category),
                WorkOrderPriority(priority),
                SlaPolicyStatus(status),
            )
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise AppError(
                code=SlaErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT,
                message="SLA category, priority, or status is invalid",
                status_code=422,
            ) from exc

    @staticmethod
    def _snapshot(record: SlaPolicy) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "respond_minutes": int(record.respond_minutes),
            "complete_minutes": int(record.complete_minutes),
            "status": str(record.status),
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _effective(
        records: tuple[SlaPolicy, ...],
        *,
        property_id: int,
    ) -> tuple[EffectiveSlaPolicy, ...]:
        active = {
            (record.property_id, record.category, record.priority): record
            for record in records
            if record.status == SlaPolicyStatus.ACTIVE.value
        }
        resolved: list[EffectiveSlaPolicy] = []
        for category in WorkOrderCategory:
            for priority in WorkOrderPriority:
                record = active.get((property_id, category.value, priority.value))
                source = "PROPERTY"
                if record is None:
                    record = active.get((None, category.value, priority.value))
                    source = "TENANT"
                if record is None:
                    source = "CODE_DEFAULT"
                    policy_id = None
                    respond_minutes = DEFAULT_SLA_RESPOND_MINUTES[priority]
                    complete_minutes = DEFAULT_SLA_COMPLETE_MINUTES[priority]
                else:
                    policy_id = record.id
                    respond_minutes = record.respond_minutes
                    complete_minutes = record.complete_minutes
                resolved.append(
                    EffectiveSlaPolicy(
                        category=category.value,
                        priority=priority.value,
                        source=source,
                        policy_id=policy_id,
                        respond_minutes=respond_minutes,
                        complete_minutes=complete_minutes,
                    )
                )
        return tuple(resolved)

    @staticmethod
    def _raise_forbidden() -> None:
        raise AppError(
            code=IamErrorCode.FORBIDDEN,
            message="Permission denied",
            status_code=403,
        )

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Literal, Self

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


SlaCategory = Literal[
    "PLUMBING",
    "ELECTRICAL",
    "HVAC",
    "CLEANING",
    "SECURITY",
    "OTHER",
]
SlaPriority = Literal["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "URGENT"]
SlaPolicyState = Literal["ACTIVE", "DISABLED"]


class PutSlaPolicyRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    tenant_id: int = Field(strict=True, gt=0)
    property_id: int | None = Field(default=None, strict=True, gt=0)
    category: SlaCategory
    priority: SlaPriority
    respond_minutes: int = Field(strict=True, ge=1, le=2_147_483_647)
    complete_minutes: int = Field(strict=True, ge=1, le=2_147_483_647)
    status: SlaPolicyState = "ACTIVE"
    expected_updated_at: datetime | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_window_order(self) -> Self:
        if self.respond_minutes > self.complete_minutes:
            raise ValueError("respond_minutes must not exceed complete_minutes")
        return self


class SlaPolicyData(BaseModel):
    id: int
    tenant_id: int
    property_id: int | None
    scope_type: Literal["TENANT", "PROPERTY"]
    category: SlaCategory
    priority: SlaPriority
    respond_minutes: int
    complete_minutes: int
    status: SlaPolicyState
    updated_at: datetime


class EffectiveSlaPolicyData(BaseModel):
    category: SlaCategory
    priority: SlaPriority
    source: Literal["PROPERTY", "TENANT", "CODE_DEFAULT"]
    policy_id: int | None
    respond_minutes: int
    complete_minutes: int


class SlaPolicyListData(BaseModel):
    property_id: int
    items: list[SlaPolicyData]
    effective: list[EffectiveSlaPolicyData]

  }
  if (Number(scope.tenant_id) !== Number(property.tenant_id)) {

function tenantScopeAllows(scope, tenantId) {

class Client:
    def __init__(self, run_id: str) -> None:
        self.run_id = run_id
        self.http = httpx.Client(base_url=API, timeout=30.0)
        self.request_ids: dict[str, str] = {}

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.http.close()

    def call(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        *,
        label: str,
        token: str | None = None,
        body: dict[str, object] | None = None,
        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        expected: tuple[int, ...] = (200,),
    ) -> tuple[int, dict[str, object]]:
        request_id = f"{self.run_id}-{label}"
        if label in self.request_ids:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Duplicate request label: {label}")
        self.request_ids[label] = request_id
        request_headers = {"X-Request-Id": request_id, **(headers or {})}
        if token:
            request_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        response = self.http.request(
            method,
            path,
            headers=request_headers,
            json=body if body is not None else None,
        )
        try:
            payload = response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{label} returned non-JSON HTTP {response.status_code}") from exc
        if response.status_code not in expected:
            error = payload.get("error") or {}
            code = error.get("code") if isinstance(error, dict) else None
            raise RuntimeError(f"{label} failed: HTTP {response.status_code} code={code}")
        return response.status_code, payload

    def data(self, *args, **kwargs) -> dict[str, object]:
        _status, payload = self.call(*args, **kwargs)
        data = payload.get("data")
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise RuntimeError(f"{kwargs.get('label', 'request')} returned no data object")
        return data

            label=f"{label}-challenge",

            body={

                "challenge_id": challenge["challenge_id"],
                "challenge_answer": _challenge_answer(str(challenge["prompt"])),

def _policy(items: list[object], *, property_id: int | None) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if (
            item.get("category") == API_CATEGORY
            and item.get("priority") == API_PRIORITY
            and item.get("property_id") == property_id
        ):

    return None


def _put_body(
    *,
    tenant_id: int,
    property_id: int | None,
    respond: int,
    complete: int,

    status: str = "ACTIVE",
) -> dict[str, object]:

def _concurrent_update(
    *,
    run_id: str,
    token: str,
    tenant_id: int,
    property_id: int,
    expected_updated_at: str,
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    barrier = threading.Barrier(2)
    candidates = ((16, 46), (18, 48))

    def send(index: int, respond: int, complete: int) -> dict[str, object]:
        request_id = f"{run_id}-concurrent-{index}"
        with httpx.Client(base_url=API, timeout=30.0) as concurrent_client:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            response = concurrent_client.put(
                "/admin/sla-policies",
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
                    "X-Request-Id": request_id,
                },
                json=_put_body(
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                    property_id=property_id,
                    respond=respond,
                    complete=complete,
                    expected_updated_at=expected_updated_at,
                ),
            )
            payload = response.json()
        return {
            "label": f"concurrent-{index}",
            "request_id": request_id,
            "status": response.status_code,
            "error_code": _error_code(payload),
            "requested": {"respond_minutes": respond, "complete_minutes": complete},
            "data": payload.get("data") if isinstance(payload.get("data"), dict) else None,
        }

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
        futures = [
            executor.submit(send, index, *candidate)
            for index, candidate in enumerate(candidates, start=1)
        ]
        return [future.result() for future in futures]


def _work_order_snapshot(engine, work_order_id: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    with engine.connect() as connection:
        row = connection.execute(
            text(
                "SELECT wo.id, wo.sla_policy_id, wo.created_at, wo.sla_due_at, "
                "sc.accept_due_at, sc.respond_due_at, sc.complete_due_at, "
                "sc.warning_at, sc.state "
                "FROM work_orders AS wo "
                "JOIN sla_clocks AS sc ON sc.work_order_id = wo.id "
                "WHERE wo.id = :work_order_id"
            ),
            {"work_order_id": work_order_id},
        ).mappings().one()
    return {
        key: value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, datetime) else value
        for key, value in row.items()
    }

)

_SLA_STOP_STATUSES = frozenset(
    {status.value for status in TERMINAL_STATUSES} | {"WAIT_CONFIRM"}
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SlaSweepResult:
    scanned: int = 0
    warnings: int = 0
    overdue: int = 0
    stopped: int = 0
    notifications: int = 0

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AssignmentSlaSweepResult:
    scanned: int = 0
    accept_timeouts: int = 0
    response_timeouts: int = 0
    notifications: int = 0
    redispatch_enqueued: int = 0

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        return asdict(self)


def _response_window_minutes(repository: WorkOrderRepository, work_order) -> int:
    priority = WorkOrderPriority(work_order.priority)
    respond_minutes, _ = sla_windows_for_priority(priority)
    policy = repository.find_sla_policy(
        tenant_id=work_order.tenant_id,
        property_id=work_order.property_id,
        category=work_order.category,
        priority=priority.value,
    )
    return respond_minutes if policy is None else int(policy.respond_minutes)


def reset_assignment_sla_deadlines(
    repository: WorkOrderRepository,
    *,
    work_order,
    now: datetime,
) -> None:
    """Start a fresh accept window whenever an assignment is created."""

    clock = repository.get_sla_clock_for_update(work_order.id)
    if clock is None:
        return
    deadline = now + timedelta(
        minutes=_response_window_minutes(repository, work_order)
    )
    clock.accept_due_at = deadline
    # The response window is restarted from the actual accept event below. Keep
    # a valid interim value for the non-null 0009 column.
    clock.respond_due_at = deadline


def reset_response_sla_deadline(
    repository: WorkOrderRepository,
    *,
    work_order,
    now: datetime,
) -> None:
    """Start the response window from staff acceptance, not order creation."""

    clock = repository.get_sla_clock_for_update(work_order.id)
    if clock is None:
        return
    clock.respond_due_at = now + timedelta(
        minutes=_response_window_minutes(repository, work_order)
    )


class SlaService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        session: Session,
        repository: WorkOrderRepository | None = None,
        settings: Settings | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._session = session
        self._repository = repository or WorkOrderRepository(session)
        self._settings = settings or get_settings()
        self._employees = EmployeeRepository(session)
        self._audit = AuditService(session)

    def sweep_due(
        self,
        *,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        limit: int = 100,
        work_order_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> SlaSweepResult:
        effective_now = now or utc_now()
        bounded_limit = min(max(limit, 1), 500)
        counts = {
            "scanned": 0,
            "warnings": 0,
            "overdue": 0,
            "stopped": 0,
            "notifications": 0,
        }
        with begin_owned_transaction(self._session):
            notifier = NotificationService(self._session, settings=self._settings)
            clocks = self._repository.list_due_sla_clocks_for_update(
                now=effective_now,
                limit=bounded_limit,
                work_order_id=work_order_id,
            )
            for clock in clocks:
                counts["scanned"] += 1
                work_order = self._repository.get_work_order(clock.work_order_id)
                if work_order is None or work_order.status in _SLA_STOP_STATUSES:
                    clock.state = SlaClockState.STOPPED.value
                    counts["stopped"] += 1
                    continue

                target = self._target_state(clock=clock, now=effective_now)
                if target is None or target.value == clock.state:
                    continue
                clock.state = target.value
                if target is SlaClockState.WARNING:
                    counts["warnings"] += 1
                else:
                    counts["overdue"] += 1

                self._repository.add_log(
                    WorkOrderLog(
                        tenant_id=work_order.tenant_id,
                        property_id=work_order.property_id,
                        work_order_id=work_order.id,
                        actor_user_id=None,
                        actor_type="SYSTEM",
                        from_status=work_order.status,
                        to_status=work_order.status,
                        process_reason=work_order.process_reason,
                        event_code=(
                            WorkOrderEvent.SLA_WARNING.value
                            if target is SlaClockState.WARNING
                            else WorkOrderEvent.SLA_OVERDUE.value
                        ),
                        request_id=f"sla-clock:{clock.id}:{target.value.lower()}",
                        payload_json={
                            "sla_state": target.value,
                            "complete_due_at": clock.complete_due_at.isoformat(),
                        },
                    )
                )

                recipients = set(
                    self._repository.list_sla_management_user_ids(
                        tenant_id=work_order.tenant_id,
                        property_id=work_order.property_id,
                    )
                )
                assignee_user_id = self._repository.get_active_assignee_user_id(
                    work_order.id
                )
                if assignee_user_id is not None:
                    recipients.add(assignee_user_id)
                for user_id in sorted(recipients):
                    notifier.enqueue(
                        tenant_id=work_order.tenant_id,
                        property_id=work_order.property_id,
                        user_id=user_id,
                        title=(
                            "工单 SLA 即将超时"
                            if target is SlaClockState.WARNING
                            else "工单 SLA 已超�?
                        ),
                        body=(
                            "Work order is approaching its completion deadline"
                            if target is SlaClockState.WARNING
                            else "Work order is overdue and requires escalation"
                        ),
                        resource_type="WORK_ORDER",
                        resource_id=work_order.id,
                    )
                    counts["notifications"] += 1
        return SlaSweepResult(**counts)

    def sweep_assignment_deadlines(
        self,
        *,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        limit: int = 100,
        work_order_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> AssignmentSlaSweepResult:
        """Expire unaccepted assignments and escalate accepted-but-idle work."""

        effective_now = now or utc_now()
        bounded_limit = min(max(limit, 1), 500)
        counts = {
            "scanned": 0,
            "accept_timeouts": 0,
            "response_timeouts": 0,
            "notifications": 0,
            "redispatch_enqueued": 0,
        }
        redispatch: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
        with begin_owned_transaction(self._session):
            notifier = NotificationService(self._session, settings=self._settings)
            records = self._repository.list_due_assignment_sla_work_orders_for_update(
                now=effective_now,
                limit=bounded_limit,
                work_order_id=work_order_id,
            )
            for record in records:
                counts["scanned"] += 1
                clock = self._repository.get_sla_clock_for_update(record.id)
                if clock is None:
                    continue
                if record.status == WorkOrderStatus.ASSIGNED.value:
                    result = self._expire_unaccepted_assignment(
                        record=record,
                        clock=clock,
                        now=effective_now,
                        notifier=notifier,
                    )
                    if result is None:
                        continue
                    notification_count, request_id = result
                    counts["accept_timeouts"] += 1
                    counts["notifications"] += notification_count
                    redispatch.append((record.id, request_id))
                    continue
                if record.status == WorkOrderStatus.ACCEPTED.value:
                    notification_count = self._escalate_response_timeout(
                        record=record,
                        clock=clock,
                        now=effective_now,
                        notifier=notifier,
                    )
                    if notification_count is None:
                        continue
                    counts["response_timeouts"] += 1
                    counts["notifications"] += notification_count

        for target_id, request_id in redispatch:
            if self._enqueue_redispatch(target_id, request_id):
                counts["redispatch_enqueued"] += 1
        return AssignmentSlaSweepResult(**counts)

    def _expire_unaccepted_assignment(
        self,
        *,
        record,
        clock,
        now: datetime,
        notifier: NotificationService,
    ) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
        assignment = self._repository.get_active_assignment_for_update(record.id)
        if (
            assignment is None
            or record.current_assignment_id != assignment.id
            or now < clock.accept_due_at
        ):
            return None
        request_id = f"sla-assignment:{assignment.id}:accept-timeout"
        assignee_user_id = self._repository.get_active_assignee_user_id(record.id)
        employee = self._employees.get_employee(assignment.employee_id)
        assignment.status = AssignmentStatus.REASSIGNED.value
        assignment.timeout_at = now
        assignment.ended_at = now
        assignment.reason = "SLA_ACCEPT_TIMEOUT"
        from app.service.incident import IncidentCapacityService

        release_load = IncidentCapacityService(
            self._session,
            work_order_repository=self._repository,
        ).should_release_load(
            work_order=record,
            assignment=assignment,
        )
        if employee is not None and release_load:
            property_record = self._repository.get_property(record.property_id)
            if property_record is not None:
                business_date = current_business_date(
                    property_record.timezone,
                    clock=lambda: now,
                )
                daily = self._employees.get_daily_status_for_update(
                    employee_id=employee.id,
                    property_id=record.property_id,
                    business_date=business_date,
                )
                if daily is not None:
                    daily.current_load = max(daily.current_load - 1, 0)

        from_status = WorkOrderStatus(record.status)
        require_legal_transition(
            from_status=from_status,
            to_status=WorkOrderStatus.PENDING_ASSIGNMENT,
            event=WorkOrderEvent.REASSIGN,
        )
        record.status = WorkOrderStatus.PENDING_ASSIGNMENT.value
        record.version += 1
        record.current_assignment_id = None
        self._repository.add_log(
            WorkOrderLog(
                tenant_id=record.tenant_id,
                property_id=record.property_id,
                work_order_id=record.id,
                actor_user_id=None,
                actor_type=WorkOrderActorType.SYSTEM.value,
                from_status=from_status.value,
                to_status=record.status,
                process_reason=record.process_reason,
                event_code=WorkOrderEvent.REASSIGN.value,
                request_id=request_id,
                payload_json={
                    "event_code": WorkOrderEvent.REASSIGN.value,
                    "reason_code": "SLA_ACCEPT_TIMEOUT",
                    "assignment_id": assignment.id,
                    "employee_id": assignment.employee_id,
                    "accept_due_at": clock.accept_due_at.isoformat(),
                },
            )
        )
        self._audit.append(
            action=AuditAction.WORK_ORDER_REASSIGNED,
            resource_type=AuditResourceType.WORK_ORDER_ASSIGNMENT,
            actor_user_id=None,
            resource_id=assignment.id,
            request_id=request_id,
            scope_type=ScopeType.PROPERTY,
            tenant_id=record.tenant_id,
            property_id=record.property_id,
            details={
                "work_order_id": record.id,
                "employee_id": assignment.employee_id,
                "status": record.status,
                "reason_code": "SLA_ACCEPT_TIMEOUT",
            },
        )
        recipients = set(
            self._repository.list_sla_management_user_ids(
                tenant_id=record.tenant_id,
                property_id=record.property_id,
            )
        )
        if assignee_user_id is not None:
            recipients.add(assignee_user_id)
        for user_id in sorted(recipients):
            notifier.enqueue(
                tenant_id=record.tenant_id,
                property_id=record.property_id,
                user_id=user_id,
                title="Work order accept timeout",
                body="The assignment timed out and was returned for automatic dispatch",
                resource_type="WORK_ORDER",
                resource_id=record.id,
            )
        return len(recipients), request_id

    def _escalate_response_timeout(
        self,
        *,
        record,
        clock,
        now: datetime,
        notifier: NotificationService,
    ) -> int | None:
        assignment = self._repository.get_active_assignment_for_update(record.id)
        if (
            assignment is None
            or record.current_assignment_id != assignment.id
            or assignment.accept_at is None
        ):
            return None
        request_id = f"sla-assignment:{assignment.id}:response-timeout"
        if self._repository.has_log_request_id(
            work_order_id=record.id,
            request_id=request_id,
        ):
            return None
        assignment.timeout_at = now
        self._repository.add_log(
            WorkOrderLog(
                tenant_id=record.tenant_id,
                property_id=record.property_id,
                work_order_id=record.id,
                actor_user_id=None,
                actor_type=WorkOrderActorType.SYSTEM.value,

            )
        )

        if assignee_user_id is not None:

                resource_type="WORK_ORDER",
                resource_id=record.id,
            )
        return len(recipients)

        if not self._settings.should_enqueue_ai_on_create:
            return False
        from app.worker.enqueue import enqueue_celery_task
        from app.worker.tasks import analyze_work_order_task

        return enqueue_celery_task(
            settings=self._settings,
            celery_task=analyze_work_order_task,
            args=(work_order_id, request_id),
            event="ai_enqueue_failed",
            extra={"work_order_id": work_order_id},
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _target_state(*, clock, now: datetime) -> SlaClockState | None:
        if now >= clock.complete_due_at:
            return SlaClockState.OVERDUE
        if clock.state == SlaClockState.OPEN.value and now >= clock.warning_at:
            return SlaClockState.WARNING
        return None
